description: The streets around a place with their recorded sales (DVF) and median price per m² over the last 5 years, the most expensive first, or ranked by how their median moved: the latest 24 months against the 24 before (falling or rising first; only streets with at least 8 sales with a floor area in each period have a change). Each street with 5 sales or more has a page on the site (url).

address.description: Street address with its postcode or city (e.g. "17 rue Gambey, 75011 Paris"), located where its sales were recorded (else its street's). Ignored when lat and lng are given.

order.description: price_desc (default), price_asc, falling (largest fall first), rising, or sales (the most sold first).

place.description: City, city start or postcode (e.g. "Carnac", "Paris 11e", "75011"); with address, the place it is in. Ignored when lat and lng are given.

name: street_prices
title: Prices street by street (France)
